hints.title: Range of Possible Answers
hints.text: The answer x must be between 1 and the length of the array inclusive.

hints.title: Sort for Fast Count
hints.text: Sorting the array allows counting elements >= x in constant time or via logarithmic lookup.

hints.title: Check Boundary Condition
hints.text: For descending sorted array, check if element at index x minus 1 is >= x and next element is strictly less than x.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every value from 1 to n with a full pass takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array once allows O(n log n) total time and O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check the boundary condition carefully so that exactly x elements satisfy the property.
